cards.name: Credit Card
cards.notes: 2% on spend; 0.5% on government, real estate, utilities/telecom; 0.5% for paying other-bank card bills via Wio (needs AED 5,000 other eligible spend; Plus plan only). Wio Credit and My Money share AED 2,500 monthly cashback cap. Wallet top-ups, cash advances excluded. Interest 3.25%/month Standard/Plus; Plus plan AED 49/month waived at AED 35,000 balance. Official bank pages/PDFs could not be read in the 2026-11-24 verification pass (fetch budget exhausted); figures remain aggregator-only. Audit 2026-11-27: Wio's own page says 'up to 0.5%' on paying other credit cards with Wio credit, up to 2,500 a month, terms apply. The AED 5,000 spend condition, the Plus-plan requirement and the 0.5%-of-limit cap come from a comparison site and are not on any Wio page we could read (the key fact statement blocks automated readers).
